task_design_intent: Keep the instruction focused on the delivery contract, available code, output report, and prohibited shortcuts.
Move the diagnosis pressure for locating every participating framework file into the skill and the verifier.
Make with_skill and without_skill differ only by environment/skills and the corresponding runtime copy logic.

live_services: one in-container framework dev server on port 3000
one in-container build and export workflow driven by local scripts
data_properties: deterministic local snapshots derived from public Next.js source files and official Next.js documentation routes
multiple scenario matrix entries so one report must cover disabled and enabled flag states
alternate route snapshot support to catch hardcoded summaries and fixed-path assumptions

principles: State the required capability and execution entrypoints before any internal file hints.
Describe the available code, local snapshots, fixture matrix, and output report as the authoritative delivery surface.
Avoid spelling out config-shared, zod schema, define-env, runtime env, or bundle-selection details in the instruction.
Explicitly prohibit replacing the current code path, modifying input data, or reducing the task to a static report.
expected_solver_discovery: Recognize that one framework flag must participate in more than one internal layer.
Find that the enabled scenario currently disappears between config loading and later execution stages.
Repair the same capability for dev, build, export, and final report paths instead of patching a single visible output.

main_tests: enabled dev scenario resolves the flag and drives the runtime module into segment-cache mode
build output captures the same flag in the emitted runtime flags artifact and in the runtime bundle manifest
export output uses the enabled runtime mode for the same scenario
final report covers both scenarios and reflects the actual build and export results
guardrails: alternate route snapshot changes route digest and summary values without code changes
report regeneration time shows the file was produced by the current run rather than checked in as a fixed answer
verifier_design.failure_target: Without-skill failures should land on action-level misses such as leaving bundle-plan files on the baseline path, patching only schema and env wiring, or fixing only one execution path while another still resolves the disabled behavior.

experiment_protocol.isolation_rule: Every experiment run must start from a fresh isolated runtime copy.
experiment_protocol.with_without_diff: The only allowed difference is whether environment/skills is present and copied into the runtime.
experiment_protocol.required_result_state: Do not finalize the README until oracle and at least three valid with-skill and without-skill comparisons have been collected.
